name: Linn County

actions.title: Microsoft Data Center Campus Siting Approval (Cedar Rapids)
actions.summary: Microsoft received local approvals to develop a large-scale data center campus near Cedar Rapids, with significant investment tied to renewable energy commitments from MidAmerican Energy. The project is part of Microsoft's multi-billion-dollar Iowa expansion.

actions.title: 18-Month Moratorium on Large-Scale Data Center Rezoning Applications
actions.summary: Linn County supervisors approved an 18-month moratorium on new applications to rezone land to the EU-3 Large-Scale Data Center district in unincorporated areas while the county updates its comprehensive plan and future land-use map.

contextBlurb: Linn County, anchored by Cedar Rapids, has become a significant node in the Iowa data center buildout. After earlier campus approvals, supervisors imposed an 18-month moratorium on new large-scale data center rezoning applications in unincorporated areas in June 2026 while the county updates its comprehensive plan and future land-use map.

name: Dallas County

actions.title: (Waukee) Meta Data Center Tax Abatement and Expansion Approvals
actions.summary: The City of Waukee in Dallas County continued approving tax incentive packages and siting permits for Meta's large data center campus, which has grown to over a billion dollars in investment and requires substantial water and power infrastructure upgrades.

actions.title: (Waukee) Data Center Zoning Ordinance Review
actions.summary: Waukee city officials began reviewing zoning ordinances to better accommodate the scale of hyperscale data center development while addressing concerns from nearby residents about noise, traffic, and visual impact.

contextBlurb: Dallas County, particularly the rapidly growing city of Waukee, has become one of Iowa's premier data center destinations, hosting Meta's massive campus. The county faces ongoing pressure to balance economic development incentives with infrastructure capacity and residential quality-of-life concerns.

name: Polk County

actions.title: (Des Moines) Iowa Legislature AI Data Center Tax Incentive — Local Implementation Discussions
actions.summary: Following Iowa's passage of statewide data center tax incentive legislation in 2024, Polk County and Des Moines officials began discussions on how local property tax abatements and infrastructure investments would align with state-level incentives to attract AI-focused data center development.

contextBlurb: Polk County and the Des Moines metro area serve as Iowa's administrative and economic hub, making them a focal point for policy discussions around state and local tax incentives for AI data centers. Local officials have been working to align Des Moines' development pipeline with Iowa's aggressive statewide push to attract hyperscale investment.
